criteria.description: The locally authorized product journeys and acceptance evidence execute against the current artifact
criteria.limitations: Synthetic data, local adapters and disposable PostgreSQL do not constitute hospital acceptance or production evidence

criteria.description: Regression, packaging, contract, persistence, browser and security checks are green for the local artifact
criteria.limitations: Representative workload, remote CI, production topology and operational recovery have not been proven

criteria.description: Known limitations, external conditions and the authority boundary are explicit and prevent an unsafe release claim
criteria.limitations: The gate intentionally verifies only the local synthetic MVP boundary and withholds hospital/production release authority

conditions.description: Hospital and production release evidence must be supplied before any real deployment or real clinical data use
conditions.impact: Blocks RELEASE_READY and deployment, but does not invalidate the local VERIFIED artifact evidence
conditions.owner: Hospital clinical owner and platform operations
conditions.due_or_trigger: Before any release decision, production configuration or real-data onboarding
conditions.verification_method: Signed clinical/privacy/identity policies, production configuration review, migration/restore/load/CI evidence and manual acceptance records

authority.decision: Accept local verification evidence while explicitly withholding hospital and production release authority
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before real clinical data, external systems, production deployment or a release decision

next_action: Resolve hospital identity/ownership and clinical policy, relational migration/EXPLAIN, production storage/AV/secrets, backup/RPO/RTO, load/CI and manual acceptance gates before RELEASE_READY
revalidation_triggers: real clinical data or hospital identity integration
relational clinical migration or destructive schema change
new CRITICAL/HIGH finding or material scope expansion
